integrity: Complete elementary proof and executable deterministic checks included; neither numerical sampling nor literature search is treated as independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only trigonometric-polynomial support functions of degree at most five; the fifth-amplitude gap coefficient is not asserted optimal. A 2010 numerical study already anticipated the cosine-only minimizer. Historical priority of an equivalent rigorous arbitrary-phase inequality is not fully settled.
title: Fifth-harmonic rigidity and a quantitative area gap for finite-Fourier bodies of constant width
